image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a circular aneroid barometer with a gold/brass metallic casing. The face is also gold-toned with black numerical markings and text. It features two main scales: an outer scale for atmospheric pressure (in inches of mercury, marked 28-31) and an inner smaller dial for relative humidity (marked 0-100%). There are two pointer hands: a long black one for the current reading and a shorter reference hand. Text on the face includes 'GENERAL', 'Change', 'Rain', 'Fair', and 'Dry'. The glass cover shows some light reflections.
